attributes.board_name: Puerto Rico Board of Nursing Examiners (Junta Examinadora de Enfermería, Departamento de Salud)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-authorized providers; PR residents: all credits from Puerto Rico providers (non-residents: at least 50%); PR certificates must carry a barcode; max 8 hours per day and 20 hours per certificate; no limit on modules, journals or internet
rules.notes: Advanced practice nurses (Práctica Avanzada) recertify every 3 years from the registration date: 50 hours, of which 20 in their specialty. Also needs ASUME certificate, criminal record certificates and malpractice insurance. Renew 90 days before expiry to avoid penalties.
rules.legal_basis: Reglamento Núm. 9651 (Educación continua para la recertificación profesional de la enfermería); Ley Núm. 254 de 31 de diciembre de 2015
